remarks: Stunning Top-Floor Condo in Prime Norwalk Location! Welcome to this beautiful 2-bedroom, 2 full-bathroom condo in one of Norwalk's most desirable neighborhoods, right on the Darien border! Just under 1200 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed space, this home offers both comfort and convenience. With an amazing open floor plan, step inside to find hardwood floors flowing through the spacious living and dining areas, which open to a private TOP deck-perfect for entertaining or unwinding with scenic views. The modern kitchen boasts granite countertops, upgraded cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a stylish tile backsplash, and tile flooring. A open window into dining area adds an even better environment for entertaining. The natural light pouring into all 3 entertaining rooms is amazing! Beautiful crown molding and trim around the home. The primary suite has ample space, a walk-in closet, and full bath. The second bedroom is generously sized, with a full bath conveniently located just across the hall. Set within a private, secure community, residents enjoy access to a beautiful pool and are just moments from local shopping, top-rated restaurants, and the train station-providing easy access to Stamford and NYC. Don't miss this opportunity to own a top-floor gem in a prime location! Schedule your showing today!
